scope: Visual layout/readability review of every supplied page PNG 01-08; no manuscript edits.
binding_note: The receipt binds the latest main.pdf SHA and the exact page PNGs actually viewed. Root separately verifies the full rerender after the page-18-only wording change.

Table 1 caption, both columns, five scientific rows and horizontal rules are fully visible. Wrapped table text is readable.
The introductory paragraph resumes below the top float; section 1.1 and footer are contained.
Section 2 heading wraps across two lines with normal-ization hyphenation; it remains readable and inside the text width.
Action, Euler equation, QS rows, reduced equation and functional (1)-(5) are legible, with contained equation numbers. The bottom paragraph clears the footer.
Spherical branch and screening equations (6)-(9), units and long numerical values fit without clipping.
Subsection 2.3 has following text; operator and principal-coefficient equations (10)-(11) are complete.
Radial equation, principal coefficients, hypergeometric solution and energy (12)-(15) are readable.
Subsection 2.4, harmonic normalization (16) and the multiline full-line projection (17) fit; the final integral and footer are separate.
Projection derivatives, axial response, monopole and finite-tail equations (18)-(21) are complete and readable.
Subsection 2.5 starts with accompanying paragraphs; the scale equation (22) is fully visible above the footer.
The remaining numerical-control paragraphs and the section 3 transition are legible.
State definition (23), Proposition 1, the piecewise time bound (24), uniform bounds (25) and Riccati equation (26) are complete. The proof continues normally to page 8.
Proof continuation, radial comparison and singular coefficients (27)-(29) are legible, with a visible proof-end mark.
The amplitude cap (30), conormal map (31), zero-flux cap (32) and final domain/time paragraph are fully contained; no formula or footer overlap was observed.

global_findings: No clipped text or equations, overlapping elements, unreadable glyphs or broken table rows observed on pages 01-08.
Equation numbers, headings, page numbers and margins are readable and contained.
An apparent header discrepancy in the tool display was investigated: the header pixel regions of pages 02-08 are identical; it is not a document defect.
